# SERVER-CONTRACT: agentic-ui agent server HTTP API

<!-- Generated by `python -m agentic_ui_server.http.contract_doc --write` from
apps/agent-server/src/agentic_ui_server/http/contract.py (DEC-034). Do not edit. -->

Reference implementation: `agentic-ui-server.pyz` 0.1.0 (Python 3.13, stdlib only).
A production backend that replaces it must serve every endpoint not marked OPTIONAL with these shapes, and must
validate statefully per chat (SV-C28, below: a REQUIREMENT).

## Required and optional endpoints (SV-C26)

- REQUIRED: `POST {base}/prompt` and `POST {base}/action` (both answer with `contractVersion`, DEC-056).
- OPTIONAL: `/cancel`, `/progress`, `/models`, `/model`, `/health`. A client probes each once; a missing one (404,
  405, network error) never fails a chat: no cancel endpoint = the client aborts its own request, no `/models` = no
  model choice, no `/progress` = a plain working state.

## Replies: text and UI (SV-C27)

- A reply = the agent's `text` + optional A2UI `messages`. The client always shows the text; `messages` may be
  empty: an `ok` answer with `messages: []` is a text-only reply (an orchestrating backend that answered without
  UI): the client shows the text, no surface changes.
- Text with a failed UI: when the UI cannot be made valid after the repairs, the answer is `fallback` with the
  agent's last `text` and either the fallback surface or `messages: []` (the JSON dropped); the client shows the
  text and, without a surface, a "UI failed" placeholder.
- Reference-server modes (TOML `[reply]`): `ui = "always"` (default: every reply must hold UI; a reply without a
  block is repaired) or `"auto"` (the agent may answer a `/prompt` with text only; UI is requested, and a reply
  without it repaired, for an `/action` and for a `/prompt` with `repairOf`); `fallback = "surface"` (default) or
  `"text"`; `surfaces = "many"` (default: refinements and actions update the shown `surfaceId`, a new topic gets a
  new surface; the generated system prompt says so) or `"single"` (every reply updates the chat's one surface).

## Stateful validation per chat (SV-C28, REQUIREMENT)

- The server keeps each chat's surface state: the components (by id, with their type) and the data model of every
  surface, after every reply it answered `ok` (deletes applied). A `fallback`, `cancelled` or error answer leaves
  it as it was; an `/action`'s `dataModel` replaces that surface's data model first (the page's inputs).
- Every new reply is merged into a COPY of that state, message by message, as the renderer applies it, and the
  WHOLE merged state is validated: an update of a surface the chat does not show and the reply does not create,
  `createSurface` of a shown surface (delete it first), a dangling or orphaned id, a missing `root`, a cycle, a
  tree deeper than 50 levels below `root`, a data-model write the renderer refuses, a bound value the prop cannot
  show → invalid → the normal repair loop with the exact problems. Only a valid reply replaces the state.
- The state is forgotten with the chat (idle reaper, `limits.forget_after_s`). The hand-over
  `validator-cases/cases.json` holds chats with the expected verdict of every step (`handover/README.md`).

## Conventions

- `{base}` = `server.base_path` (default `/api`): a path (`/some-path/api`) or an absolute URL
  (`https://someserver.com/agent-api`, its path is used). The web page keeps the same value as its one endpoint
  constant. Host/port: `server.host`/`server.port` (default `127.0.0.1:8787`).
- JSON in and out (UTF-8, `Content-Type: application/json`). No streaming: a request returns once, after the whole
  agent turn and its repairs; the page shows a working state meanwhile (poll the optional progress endpoint for
  attempt details).
- Request bodies with `Content-Length` or `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`; body limit `server.max_body_bytes` (default
  1048576) → 413. CORS only for `server.cors_origins` (default none = same origin); preflight `OPTIONS` → 204.
- One agent conversation per `chatId`; requests of one chat run in order, at most 4 waiting (else 429).
  Different chats run in parallel.
- Duplicate retry: a `/prompt` (or the `agent.retry` action) whose text equals the chat's still running prompt (a client
  that gave up after a proxy timeout and retried), or any `/prompt` / `/action` carrying the running request's
  `requestId` (A4-08), joins the running request: one agent turn, both answers carry its outcome. A different
  request of the chat waits behind it (FIFO). Keep a proxy's read timeout at least `timeouts.request_s` (default
  600 s) so the first answer is not cut off.
- Contract version (DEC-056): every JSON answer, errors included, carries `contractVersion` = `<catalogId>
  sha256:<12 hex>` of the catalog the server validates against (`handover/manifest.json` `contractVersion`). A client
  built for another version (or an answer without the field) must not render the answer.

## Endpoints

| method | path | optional | purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `{base}/prompt` | no | Pasted data + instruction → valid UI (or the fallback) |
| POST | `{base}/action` | no | A button action (+ the surface's data model) → UI update |
| POST | `{base}/cancel` | yes | Cancels the chat's running turn (ACP session/cancel); the waiting /prompt or /action returns `cancelled`. |
| GET | `{base}/progress` | yes | Live state of the chat's current (or last) request, for the working message (poll while waiting). |
| GET | `{base}/models` | yes | Models the agent CLI offers (ACP session/new), the CLI default and the chat's current choice. |
| POST | `{base}/model` | yes | Sets the chat's model (an id from /models; `""` = CLI default); applied on the chat's next turn. |
| GET | `{base}/health` | yes | Liveness + agent CLI found + live agent processes (503 when the CLI is not found). |

## Repair loop and outcomes

- One request = the agent's first reply + up to `repair.max_attempts` (default 3) repair turns in the same
  agent session: at most 4 replies. Each reply is extracted (`<a2ui-json>` block) and validated against the
  catalog merged into the chat's surfaces (SV-C28); an invalid reply gets its problems (at most 50, each at most
  300 characters, plus a count of the rest) and the shown surfaces sent back in one repair turn.
- Valid reply → `status: ok` with the messages (never an invalid draft).
- Attempts used up, turn timeout, request timeout (`timeouts.request_s`, default 600 s), agent crash or agent
  error → `status: fallback`, `fallback: true`, `text` = the last reply's prose, `messages` = the fixed fallback
  surface (`reply.fallback = "surface"`: `fallback.json`, surface `agent-fallback`, deleted first so it is valid again in
  the same chat) or `[]` (`reply.fallback = "text"`), `errors` = the last problems (capped like the repair turn),
  `reason` = the cause.
- The fallback's button sends the action `agent.retry`: `/action` with that event re-sends the chat's last prompt.

## Cancel

- `POST {base}/cancel` from any second request (it does not wait behind the running turn) sends ACP
  `session/cancel`; the waiting `/prompt` or `/action` returns 200 with `status: cancelled`, `messages: []`,
  `fallback: false`. An agent that ignores the cancel is killed after `timeouts.cancel_grace_s`. A request still
  waiting for an agent slot (`/progress`: `running`, `attempt` 0) is cancelled too: it returns `cancelled` at once,
  no prompt is sent (`cancelled: true` in the answer).
- Shutdown is not a cancel: a request the server stopped because it shuts down (SIGTERM, deploy restart) answers
  503 `shutting_down` (retry later), never 200 `cancelled`, so a client can tell it from the user's own Cancel.

## Models

- `GET {base}/models` lists what the agent CLI offers (ACP `session/new` → `models.availableModels`,
  `currentModelId`); `POST {base}/model` sets a chat's model, applied on its next `/prompt` or `/action` turn;
  `""` returns to the CLI default. An id not offered → 400 `unknown_model`. The outcome's `model` and, after a turn,
  `/models` `current` name the model the turn really ran: a model call the agent refused is retried on the next
  turn and never reported as applied.

## Errors

Every non-200 response (except the 500 of `/prompt`/`/action`, which carries the fallback outcome) is:

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `error` | string | yes | machine code: bad_json, bad_request, not_found, method_not_allowed, too_large, queue_full, unknown_model, … |
| `message` | string | yes | human-readable detail (never contains secrets) |
| `contractVersion` | string | yes | DEC-056: `<catalogId> sha256:<12 hex>` of the catalog this server validates against (= handover/manifest.json `contractVersion`); in every JSON answer, errors included. A client built for another contract (or an answer without it) must not render: show a version mismatch instead |

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | OK (also for a fallback or a cancelled request: read `status`) |
| 204 | CORS preflight answered |
| 400 | bad JSON, a missing/mistyped field, or an unknown model |
| 404 | unknown path, or no request seen yet for this chat (progress) |
| 405 | known path, wrong method |
| 413 | body larger than server.max_body_bytes |
| 429 | too many requests already queued for this chat (limits.max_queue_per_chat) or waiting across all chats (limits.max_waiting) |
| 500 | server error; prompt/action answer with the fallback body (`status: fallback`, `reason: server_error`) |
| 503 | server shutting down (`shutting_down`, also for a request the shutdown stopped: retry later; a user's own cancel is a 200 `cancelled`), or the agent CLI cannot be started / is not found |

## Endpoint reference

### `POST {base}/prompt`

Pasted data + instruction → valid UI (or the fallback). Waits for the whole turn and repairs (no streaming).

Request (JSON body):

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | string | yes | conversation id chosen by the client; one agent session per chat (1..200 printable characters) |
| `text` | string | yes | the user's paste and instruction, as typed |
| `requestId` | string | no | A4-08: id of one logical request, kept by the client's retry of it: a request with the chat's running request's `requestId` joins it (one agent turn, the same answer); without it a `/prompt` joins only a running one with the same `text` (1..200 printable characters) |
| `repairOf` | string | no | DEC-064: the `turnId` of the chat's latest `ok` reply that the client rejected (an expression or render error, its own validator): the server first rolls the chat's surface state back to before that turn, then runs this prompt (the client's exact errors) as its repair, checked against what the client shows; any other id changes nothing. A server without the rollback ignores it (1..200 printable characters) |

Response (200):

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | string | yes | echo of the request's chatId |
| `status` | string | yes | `ok` (text + valid UI, or text only), `fallback` (UI failed) or `cancelled` |
| `messages` | array | yes | A2UI v0.9 messages, always valid for the catalog; `[]` for a text-only `ok`, a `cancelled`, and a `fallback` with `reply.fallback = "text"` (SV-C27) |
| `text` | string | yes | the agent's prose outside the UI block, always shown (kept in a fallback) |
| `fallback` | boolean | yes | `true` exactly when status is `fallback` |
| `errors` | array | yes | problems of the last invalid reply (strings); `[]` when ok |
| `attempts` | integer | yes | agent replies used: 1 first reply + repairs |
| `reason` | string | no | fallback cause: invalid, timeout, crash, agent_error, start_failed, server_error |
| `durationMs` | integer | yes | wall time of the request |
| `model` | string | no | the model the turn ran (the agent accepted it); null = the CLI default |
| `turnId` | string | no | DEC-064: `ok` only (else null): the id of this reply in the chat's surface state; a `/prompt` repairing it sends it as `repairOf` |
| `contractVersion` | string | yes | DEC-056: `<catalogId> sha256:<12 hex>` of the catalog this server validates against (= handover/manifest.json `contractVersion`); in every JSON answer, errors included. A client built for another contract (or an answer without it) must not render: show a version mismatch instead |

Status codes: `200`, `400`, `413`, `429`, `500`, `503`

Example:

`POST {base}/prompt`

```json
{
  "chatId": "chat-42",
  "text": "Имя,Сумма\nАнна,1200\nБорис,2300\n\nПокажи таблицей с итогом."
}
```

→ `200`

```json
{
  "chatId": "chat-42",
  "status": "ok",
  "messages": [
    {
      "version": "v0.9",
      "createSurface": {
        "surfaceId": "orders",
        "catalogId": "urn:agentic-ui:catalog:ui-kit-one:v1"
      }
    },
    {
      "version": "v0.9",
      "updateComponents": {
        "surfaceId": "orders",
        "components": [
          {
            "id": "root",
            "component": "Flex",
            "direction": "column",
            "gap": "2",
            "children": [
              "title",
              "total"
            ]
          },
          {
            "id": "title",
            "component": "Heading",
            "text": "Заказы",
            "size": "md"
          },
          {
            "id": "total",
            "component": "Text",
            "text": {
              "path": "/total"
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "version": "v0.9",
      "updateDataModel": {
        "surfaceId": "orders",
        "path": "/total",
        "value": "Итого: 3 500 ₽"
      }
    }
  ],
  "text": "Готово: таблица заказов с итогом.",
  "fallback": false,
  "errors": [],
  "attempts": 1,
  "reason": null,
  "durationMs": 24500,
  "model": null,
  "turnId": null,
  "contractVersion": "urn:agentic-ui:catalog:ui-kit-one:v1 sha256:672c5b291a43"
}
```

### `POST {base}/action`

A button action (+ the surface's data model) → UI update. `agent.retry` re-sends the chat's last prompt.

Request (JSON body):

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | string | yes | conversation id chosen by the client; one agent session per chat (1..200 printable characters) |
| `surfaceId` | string | yes | surface the action came from |
| `event` | object | yes | `{name, context?}` from the component's action |
| `dataModel` | any | no | the surface's current data model (SV-C28: replaces the server's copy of that surface's data before the reply is checked) |
| `requestId` | string | no | A4-08: id of one logical request, kept by the client's retry of it: a request with the chat's running request's `requestId` joins it (one agent turn, the same answer); without it a `/prompt` joins only a running one with the same `text` (1..200 printable characters) |

Response (200):

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | string | yes | echo of the request's chatId |
| `status` | string | yes | `ok` (text + valid UI, or text only), `fallback` (UI failed) or `cancelled` |
| `messages` | array | yes | A2UI v0.9 messages, always valid for the catalog; `[]` for a text-only `ok`, a `cancelled`, and a `fallback` with `reply.fallback = "text"` (SV-C27) |
| `text` | string | yes | the agent's prose outside the UI block, always shown (kept in a fallback) |
| `fallback` | boolean | yes | `true` exactly when status is `fallback` |
| `errors` | array | yes | problems of the last invalid reply (strings); `[]` when ok |
| `attempts` | integer | yes | agent replies used: 1 first reply + repairs |
| `reason` | string | no | fallback cause: invalid, timeout, crash, agent_error, start_failed, server_error |
| `durationMs` | integer | yes | wall time of the request |
| `model` | string | no | the model the turn ran (the agent accepted it); null = the CLI default |
| `turnId` | string | no | DEC-064: `ok` only (else null): the id of this reply in the chat's surface state; a `/prompt` repairing it sends it as `repairOf` |
| `contractVersion` | string | yes | DEC-056: `<catalogId> sha256:<12 hex>` of the catalog this server validates against (= handover/manifest.json `contractVersion`); in every JSON answer, errors included. A client built for another contract (or an answer without it) must not render: show a version mismatch instead |

Status codes: `200`, `400`, `413`, `429`, `500`, `503`

Example:

`POST {base}/action`

```json
{
  "chatId": "chat-42",
  "surfaceId": "orders",
  "event": {
    "name": "sort",
    "context": {
      "by": "Сумма"
    }
  }
}
```

→ `200`

```json
{
  "chatId": "chat-42",
  "status": "fallback",
  "messages": [
    {
      "version": "v0.9",
      "deleteSurface": {
        "surfaceId": "agent-fallback"
      }
    },
    {
      "version": "v0.9",
      "createSurface": {
        "surfaceId": "agent-fallback",
        "catalogId": "urn:agentic-ui:catalog:ui-kit-one:v1"
      }
    },
    {
      "version": "v0.9",
      "updateComponents": {
        "surfaceId": "agent-fallback",
        "components": [
          {
            "id": "root",
            "component": "Container",
            "maxW": "container.sm",
            "py": "8",
            "children": [
              "card"
            ]
          },
          {
            "id": "card",
            "component": "Flex",
            "direction": "column",
            "align": "center",
            "gap": "4",
            "p": "8",
            "children": [
              "icon",
              "title",
              "body",
              "retry"
            ]
          },
          {
            "id": "icon",
            "component": "Icon",
            "name": "warning",
            "boxSize": "10"
          },
          {
            "id": "title",
            "component": "Heading",
            "text": "Не удалось построить интерфейс",

          },

  "contractVersion": "urn:agentic-ui:catalog:ui-kit-one:v1 sha256:672c5b291a43"
```

### `POST {base}/cancel` (OPTIONAL)

Cancels the chat's running turn (ACP session/cancel); the waiting /prompt or /action returns `cancelled`.

Request (JSON body):

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | string | yes | conversation id chosen by the client; one agent session per chat (1..200 printable characters) |

Response (200):

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | string | yes | conversation id chosen by the client; one agent session per chat (1..200 printable characters) |
| `cancelled` | boolean | yes | the chat's unfinished request was marked (it ends `cancelled`) or its running turn got the cancel |
| `contractVersion` | string | yes | DEC-056: `<catalogId> sha256:<12 hex>` of the catalog this server validates against (= handover/manifest.json `contractVersion`); in every JSON answer, errors included. A client built for another contract (or an answer without it) must not render: show a version mismatch instead |

Status codes: `200`, `400`

Example:

`POST {base}/cancel`

```json
{
  "chatId": "chat-42"
}
```

→ `200`

```json
{
  "chatId": "chat-42",
  "cancelled": true,
  "contractVersion": "urn:agentic-ui:catalog:ui-kit-one:v1 sha256:672c5b291a43"
}
```

### `GET {base}/progress` (OPTIONAL)

Live state of the chat's current (or last) request, for the working message (poll while waiting).

Request (query parameters):

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | string | yes | conversation id chosen by the client; one agent session per chat (1..200 printable characters) |

Response (200):

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | string | yes | conversation id chosen by the client; one agent session per chat (1..200 printable characters) |
| `state` | string | yes | running, repairing, done, fallback or cancelled |
| `attempt` | integer | yes | current reply number (1 = first reply, 2.. = repairs; 0 = queued) |
| `maxAttempts` | integer | yes | 1 + repair.max_attempts |
| `errors` | array | yes | problems of the last invalid reply |
| `errorCount` | integer | yes | len(errors) |
| `elapsedMs` | integer | yes | since the request started (frozen when finished) |
| `contractVersion` | string | yes | DEC-056: `<catalogId> sha256:<12 hex>` of the catalog this server validates against (= handover/manifest.json `contractVersion`); in every JSON answer, errors included. A client built for another contract (or an answer without it) must not render: show a version mismatch instead |

Status codes: `200`, `400`, `404`

Example:

`GET {base}/progress?chatId=chat-42`

→ `200`

```json
{
  "chatId": "chat-42",
  "state": "repairing",
  "attempt": 2,
  "maxAttempts": 4,
  "errorCount": 1,
  "elapsedMs": 31200,
  "errors": [
    "/updateComponents/components/2: unknown property 'bogus'"
  ],
  "contractVersion": "urn:agentic-ui:catalog:ui-kit-one:v1 sha256:672c5b291a43"
}
```

### `GET {base}/models` (OPTIONAL)

| field | type | required | meaning |

| `default` | string | no | the CLI's current model (used when a chat chose none) |

A client built for another contract (or an answer without it) must not render: show a version mismatch instead |

Status codes: `200`, `503`

Example:

`GET {base}/models?chatId=chat-42`

→ `200`

```json

  "models": [
    {
      "id": "model-a",
```
